bot.help_commands:
/concerts — concerts in the next 30 days
/concerts name — search for a concert or artist
Or just send a concert or artist name
/artists name — find and follow an artist
/subscriptions — see and manage followed artists
/favorites — favorite concerts
/city city — show concerts in a city
/city all — concerts in all cities
/language ru|en — choose a language
